title: ArcFarms short mine shifts and completion rewards 2026-10-23
assumptions: Scenarios are sensitivity assumptions, not measured gameplay cadence. low/base/high: 5/15/30 participating accounts across a day, 0.5/1/2 personal hours, average simultaneous work party 1/2/4.

Each account supplies 120/360/720 useful matching ore breaks per active hour. Effective group rates are 120/720/2880. Individual share is 100/50/25%; any positive share gets a full payout under existing rules.

Average quota over unchanged deterministic four-order rotation: 436 before, 54.5 after. Incident and travel overhead: 10/6/4 minutes before, 8/4/2 after; both add the unchanged 1-minute cooldown. New shorter overhead includes grapple travel and simpler factory, not a measured speedup.

Expected cycles may be fractional over a day because this is a steady-state sensitivity, not a daily guaranteed floor. Daily operating occupancy is 2.5/7.5/15 mine-hours and remains within 24h for the single mine.
Mine has no personal daily cap or network weekly budget. Participant counts do not assert actual population. Other jobs/farm hours are not summed into this model.
Difficulty=100+min(quota,100)//2+10 for one event. Before 160%; after coal138/foundry142/deep135/crystal134. Tangible quantities floor individually. Mine has no Farm reward perk or MARKET multiplier.

After money base200, XP base300, one guaranteed exclusive weighted item bundle (50/30/15/5). No fixed items, command rewards or premium tokens. Grant identity and durable pending/claim protocol remain existing.

Disposable savings assume retaining 80% of direct completion coins after an unspecified 20% expense allowance. The allowance is not an observed sink and is not included as monetary burn. Item conversion is excluded from savings.

Current SELL remains an alternative; tracked Ores.yml rates are a separate nominal sensitivity, not a live quote. Observed current shop sales and live resource contracts confirm conversion exists. Future SELL-off sets only shop redemption to zero, never the base payout or eligible contract route.

Raw mine blocks still do not drop items or XP. External jobs/quests and any pre-existing triggers are unchanged and not assumed paid here. No buy-process-sell loop is introduced: rewards require managed ore actions and one event; inventory resources do not satisfy extraction quotas.
